page.layout: One printed page (208) in the centre-left of the scan: a single text column with a running head at the top and a page number at the top left. A line-initial "I." stands in the left margin beside the paragraph "Sed cujus sit". The neighbouring page at the right, cut off by the gutter, is left out as edge.

main_text.p: juxta tenorem facultatis sibi à Principe concessæ legitimè latas, obligare omnia membra earundem societatum, & quotquot earum jurisdictioni se regimini subduntur, eósque solos, per se, directè & vi suâ: ast virtute supremæ Majestatis Regiæ, cujus authoritate nituntur, & à quâ vim suam omnem & authoritatem accipiunt, obligare aliquo-tenus & indirectè universos & singulos totius Regni subditos. Sed utriusque obligationis nec eadem ratio est, nec gradus idem. Obligant enim hæ L-ges, suos, quidem, ut eas diligenter observent: ri-quo[?] vero hactenus tantum obligant, ne eas aliquo modo violent, imminuantve, aut earum observatio-nem impediant.
main_text.head: XXIX. Dubium Quintum, de Legibus Ecclesiasticis in specie.
main_text.p: Posse de novo condi Leges de ritibus, rebus & personis Ecclesiasticis, omnibúsque sacri cultus externi circumstantiis ad ordinem, honestatem & ædificationem spectantibus, extra eas quæ sunt à Christo & ejus Apostolis in sacris literis traditæ; adeo manifesta res est, & rationi consentanea, ut perversi judicii obstinatique animi se suspicione ægrè liberaverit, qui siccus & sobrius negaverit. Sed cujus sit Ecclesiasticas Leges condere, ex quo in diversa studia abiere Theologi, parum inter partes convenit.I. Pontificii, qui clericos omni civilis Magistratus Jurisdictione exemptos volunt, (de quâ controversiâ non est hunc disputandi locus,) Episcopis solis, inque eis summo Pontifici maxime, quem Oecumenicum Episcopum prædicant, hoc juris asserunt, ut ipsis Leges condere liceat, quæ non Clericorum modò sed & Laicorum conscientias obligent; etiam sine consensu vel licentiâ Magistratus Politici. Papistæ hunc articulum, ut & alios non paucos, (manentes tantùm personâ, dogmate non mutato,) ampl[?]

page.notes: Right of the gutter there is a strip of the neighbouring page (209); it is cut off and left out. The left page's own right edge at the gutter is partly hidden, so a few words near the line ends may be cut. The last line is partly covered at the bottom right; "amplectuntur" and the catchword are read from fragments, both doubtful. "quo" at the line end of "ri-quo" is doubtful (possibly a word such as "quoque" or "rursus"); the hyphen in "L-ges" and "ri-" is as printed. "exemptos" and "Episcopum" are read with some doubt because of the print.
